$Comment: A Gathering lesson on the trainer's board: mine ore out in the world. The step names Ore_ with PREFIX matching, so every ore block counts (Ore_Copper_Stone, Ore_Iron_Basalt and the rest) and nothing else; name one metal (Ore_Iron) to narrow it. TextKey words the step as ore. Pay and the mastery gate come from Mmo_Lesson_Base.
